references.text: This version of the brothers' lie in 42:32 emphasizes the dramatic tension and Joseph's control over the situation by repeating the same excuse.
Explains the context for the lie in 42:13 by showing how Joseph's question forced the mention of the youngest brother.
Direct cause-and-effect: This question from Joseph triggered the lie in 42:13.
Highlights the source of the brothers' knowledge about their family composition that they use in the lie.
